summary_en: NEC Corporation commenced a tender offer for its own shares on November 13, 2026. Details regarding the number of shares, acquisition price, and maximum acquisition amount were disclosed in the November 9, 2026 press release.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Own Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, NEC Corporation announced the commencement of a tender offer for its own shares, effective November 13, 2026. The Board of Directors had previously resolved on November 9, 2026 to conduct this share acquisition under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the Company's articles of incorporation, with the tender offer serving as the specific acquisition method. The commencement notice confirms that all prerequisite conditions for implementing the tender offer have been satisfied.

Detailed terms and conditions of the tender offer, including the number of shares to be acquired, acquisition price, maximum acquisition amount, and intended completion date, were disclosed in the November 9, 2026 press release and are not repeated in this commencement notice. The tender offer is structured to comply with applicable Japanese securities regulations and excludes participation from US-based investors and transactions conducted through US securities exchange facilities.
